description: A black USB hub with a connected cable sits on the green bedspread near a pillow, and a small white adapter dongle lies in front of it. The left hand reaches forward to the hub while the right hand steadies it, then the left hand pulls the white dongle’s plug out of the hub and sets it down; next, the right hand grips the black cable’s USB end, lifts it slightly, and reinserts it into the hub before letting go so both hands withdraw.
